findings.title: Removed optional-group default bypasses shown-definition binding
findings.root_cause: Binding checked only for current defaults_used; removed default yields empty list and Ready despite stale shown definition
findings.counterexample: ZeroOrOne shown default a, omitted UseDeclaredDefaults, retain binding then set default None; pin candidate; success drops a instead of Rediscovery

findings.title: Unresolved choice erases known ordinary-feature implications
findings.root_cause: Only required declarations reach solver for NeedsSelection; already explicit ordinary activation dependencies are added only in Ready branch
findings.counterexample: Existing unreachable-group fixture before bad.optional=false: newest ordinary activates optional bad conflicting blocker, but returns NeedsSelection instead of older good candidate

scope: two supported-surface corrections; no full suite/C3 integration/new engine required
